title: Levigate
summary: LEV'IGATE, verb transitive [Latin lavigo, from lavis, smooth, Gr.] 1. In pharmacy and chimistry, to rub or grind to a fine impalpable powder; to make fine, soft and smooth. 2. To plane; to polish. LEV
